name: 2-Block Littlestone Dimension of the Branching Batch-Tree Class
value: $bn$ if $b$ is even; $1$ if $b=1$; otherwise $\max\{b,(b-1)n\}\le B_2\le bn$
details: For construction width $b\ge1$ and height $n\ge1$. Query block size $k$ is a separate fixed integer; the general block catalogue parameter uses $k>2$. Any asymptotic statement fixes $b,k$ and lets $n$ grow.
proof: Apply the general block argument for this family (value record 1088), which is proved for all $k\ge2$, at $k=2$. In particular the slice $b=2$ has exact value $2n$. No exact value is asserted here for odd $b>1$, only the displayed bounds.
references: Direct finite tree construction, with independent checks in the branching-batch-tree regression.
